mapper.select: SELECT t.owner_id,t.id,t.purpose,t.status,t.revision,t.manifest_json,t.manifest_hash,t.candidate_json, t.created_at,t.updated_at, (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_candidate_decision WHERE owner_id=t.owner_id AND task_id=t.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_question_decision WHERE owner_id=t.owner_id AND task_id=t.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_expression_decision WHERE owner_id=t.owner_id AND task_id=t.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_preparation_plan_decision WHERE owner_id=t.owner_id AND task_id=t.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_relation_decision WHERE owner_id=t.owner_id AND task_id=t.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_jd_requirement_decision WHERE owner_id=t.owner_id AND task_id=t.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_fact_draft_decision WHERE owner_id=t.owner_id AND task_id=t.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_feedback_decision WHERE owner_id=t.owner_id AND task_id=t.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_follow_up WHERE owner_id=t.owner_id AND task_id=t.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_evaluation WHERE owner_id=t.owner_id AND task_id=t.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_comparison WHERE owner_id=t.owner_id AND task_id=t.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_answer_rewrite WHERE owner_id=t.owner_id AND task_id=t.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_material_qa_source WHERE owner_id=t.owner_id AND task_id=t.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_source_qa_source WHERE owner_id=t.owner_id AND task_id=t.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_knowledge_source WHERE owner_id=t.owner_id AND task_id=t.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_question_source WHERE owner_id=t.owner_id AND task_id=t.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_preparation_source WHERE owner_id=t.owner_id AND task_id=t.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_material_draft_source WHERE owner_id=t.owner_id AND task_id=t.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_training_draft_source WHERE owner_id=t.owner_id AND task_id=t.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_review_draft_source WHERE owner_id=t.owner_id AND task_id=t.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_relation_source WHERE owner_id=t.owner_id AND task_id=t.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_fact_draft_source WHERE owner_id=t.owner_id AND task_id=t.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_fact_draft_material WHERE owner_id=t.owner_id AND task_id=t.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_relation_evidence_source WHERE owner_id=t.owner_id AND task_id=t.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_relation_evidence_material WHERE owner_id=t.owner_id AND task_id=t.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_relation_feedback_draft_source WHERE owner_id=t.owner_id AND task_id=t.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_draft_knowledge_input WHERE owner_id=t.owner_id AND task_id=t.id)) AS other_purpose_uses FROM ai_task t WHERE t.owner_id=#{owner} AND t.id=#{taskId}
SELECT owner_id,task_id,status,target_card_id,target_version_id,created_at FROM ai_card_draft_decision WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND task_id=#{taskId}

SELECT v.owner_id,v.item_id,v.id,v.version_number AS number,v.title,v.body,v.created_at, i.owner_id AS item_owner_id,i.id AS actual_item_id,i.kind,i.status FROM knowledge_version v LEFT JOIN knowledge_item i ON i.owner_id=v.owner_id AND i.id=v.item_id WHERE v.owner_id=#{owner} AND v.id=#{versionId}
SELECT owner_id,id,status,revision,current_version_id,version_number,created_at,updated_at FROM memory_card WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{cardId}
